content.text: Basically the same issue- the audit stream's ns prefix declaration is in the root element on export, which means subsequently pulling just the ds content out yields an invalid document.
This is a critical bug, as it is a blocker. I don't know of any possible workaround.
I should be able to test it, should this be fixed during this release cycle.
If it is pushed for a later release I don't know whether I will still working on this area but I think there is more people suffering from it and willing to give it a try.

I agree that this is critical, but the problem is not in the Fedora Commons Repository software: It is in the FCSU storage utility, which is released and managed as a separate artifact.  Thus it doesn't impact the Fedora 3.7 release schedule.
I am working with fscu to try to migrate from legacy to akubra low level storage.
I configured both lls appropriately and run the command below.

Then after sometime (I think it uses a DB to stage the file names to transfer) I can see messages about the transfer progress, however I see messages, like the one at the end of the e-mail, very often after some examination it seems that objects that contain an xml entry for audit:auditTrail won't work and just be ignored by fscu.
Has anyone have some advice on how to make fscu work properly with those entries?

renderedFields.description:
Hi all,

I am working with fscu to try to migrate from legacy to akubra low level storage.

I configured both lls appropriately and run the command below.

/opt/fedora/fedora-3.6/fcrepo-store-util-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT/bin$ ./fcsu copy legacy akubra

Then after sometime (I think it uses a DB to stage the file names to transfer) I can see messages about the transfer progress, however I see messages, like the one at the end of the e-mail, very often after some examination it seems that objects that contain an xml entry for audit:auditTrail won't work and just be ignored by fscu.

Has anyone have some advice on how to make fscu work properly with those entries?

Thanks,
Javier
